review.rationale: The supplied frozen Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original specification. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, the paired case identifier, and the task keys are consistent. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; ready with no blocking reasons is therefore appropriate for C, while a material unresolved DEC-001 must still block paired B at decisions. The acceptance criteria consistently require rejection-value identity, explicit undefined versus omitted-argument behavior, and compatibility for running tasks and rejectOnClear=false. The complete supplied source supports the precise four-file binding scope: index.js and the maintained index.d.ts own the API, and test.js and index.test-d.ts provide runtime and compile-time regression coverage through the configured xo && ava && tsd entry point. Existing correct forwarding through limitFunction need not be edited merely to satisfy scope. The implementation and dependent independent-verification tasks are consistent with the PRD. Their distinct allowed agents have the relevant supplied active project-scoped capability claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async, integration.consumer, JavaScript, TypeScript, API contracts, failure handling, and automated testing; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The independent active reviewer satisfies the stated earlier review prerequisite without needing execution claims. Pending security.authorization claims are not treated as trusted capabilities or as requirements of this bounded change. Repository identity and file fingerprints align across the supplied records; the source-manifest, evaluation-source, and normalized PRD fingerprint differences have explicit, coherent provenance. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. Historical operations are retained as old-version evidence rather than fresh candidates, consistent with project-scoped attestation reuse and the stated pre-candidate isolation. I relied on the supplied Service-bound fingerprint and provenance assertions; I did not recompute digests, execute code, attest human confirmation, or inspect candidate outputs.
